legacy_cells.B: Bayesian Wavelet Regression for Multiscale Signal Modeling: Mathematical Foundations Uncertainty-Aware Inference and Applications in Neuroscience and Vision Science
legacy_cells.I: 046_2026_Bayesian Wavelet Regression for Multiscale Signal Modeling Mathematical Foundations Uncertainty-Aware Inference and Applications in Neuroscience .pdf
legacy_cells.FM: Synthesizes Bayesian wavelet regression and nonlocal-prior methods for neuro-retinal signal modeling, uncertainty-aware inference, and explainability.
legacy_cells.FO: Authors identify limitations in computational scalability, cross-scale dependency modeling, multimodal uncertainty propagation, prior sensitivity, reproducibility across acquisition environments, and real-world clinical validation.
legacy_cells.FP: Authors propose Bayesian deep learning, adaptive neural wavelets, graph wavelets, foundation models, scalable posterior inference, and hybrid explainable AI as future directions.
legacy_cells.FQ: The authors identify multimodal retina–brain integration and clinically validated uncertainty-aware modeling as underdeveloped.
legacy_cells.FR: Secondary literature synthesis only; the paper reports no new data analysis or paper-specific model evaluation, so it does not demonstrate an implemented healthcare world model, action-conditioned rollouts, or planning.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M9 Safety & governance; M10 Clinician interface & lifecycle
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Carry the paper’s governance and evaluation considerations into a separate safety/lifecycle service; they do not validate a dynamics model.
legacy_cells.FU: Reviewer mapping (KB §20): Prospective evaluation & lifecycle governance
legacy_cells.FX: Title and abstract (p. 1); Introduction (pp. 2–8); Methods and screening (pp. 9–11); mathematical foundations, priors, inference, and uncertainty (pp. 12–31); hierarchical and multimodal frameworks and application synthesis (pp. 31–39); comparison tables, challenges, future work, translation, and conclusions (pp. 40–49); appendices and references checked (pp. 50–60). The review’s relevant tables (Tables 1–12) were inspected. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: A:I left unchanged; the PDF did not directly contradict prefilled values. This is a secondary review, not an implementation/evaluation paper.
